notes.title: Traveler's Bastion - Balance and DLC Attack Update - April 26, 2023
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] DLC Auto-Attack Upgrades are here!
[*] Same mechanics as all other Auto-Attack upgrades. Six total upgrades per attack with three attacks per character and four characters (Minus Cade's Uppercut preview) is 66 new upgrades!
[*] Reworked Sanctuary! It's not explained in the description, but the Behemoth can now attack and aggro multiple enemies at once, giving it the chance to wipe out multiple enemies. Statwise, Sanctuary has been buffed as well
[*] Increased enemy difficulty scaling on all difficulties
[*] Minor enemy buffs
[*] Recoloured a bunch of hard-to-read (albeit pretty :( ) rainbow text
[*] Fixed a bug where Ace’s Spell Affinities would apply strangely in the Spell Mayhem sidequest
[*] Made more balance changes to some Attacks to compensate for the new upgrades
[*] Dawn’s Spear attack nerfed
[*] Fixed minor bugs revolving around DLC auto-attacks
[*] Reworded additional confusing or inconsistent Attack descriptions
[*] Fixed a bug revolving around specific summons
[/list]
Hope these work out well! I'm glad I was able to do justice to my favourite character (Dawn) and hope maybe your favourites will be that much more exciting too! Thanks for your support <3
- Simon

notes.title: Traveler's Bastion - Auto-Attack Upgrades - April 15, 2023
notes.notes:
Finally! Auto-Attack Upgrades are here!
[list]
[*] Auto-Attacks are upgraded twice throughout a run, each upgrade having two paths, meaning there are six attack upgrades altogether for each character, and 78 currently implemented overall
[*] Most upgrades aren’t just simple stat boosts! Each one changes how the ability functions to match your build and play style
[*] Unfortunately, the DLC character attack upgrades have not yet been fully implemented, each for the time being will simply have their power increased to compensate. Keep an eye out for them in a future update!
[*] (Actually, kind of a lie, we have one DLC attack upgrade path completed as a preview to the lovely players supporting us! Try using Cade’s Uppercut if you’re interested, wink wink)
[*] Sierra’s Spray attack has been reworked! This change was a long time coming, but I’m happy with how it turned out
[*] Training now properly affects field spells, such as Lava Spurt and Blight
[*] Fixed the Game Recap Victory and Defeat screens to properly display Spell Techniques
[*] Nerfed Plague (again lol)
[*] Made balance changes to some Attacks to compensate for the change
[*] Updated some visuals
[*] Reworded some confusing or inconsistent Attack descriptions
[*] Fixed some bugs revolving around Attacks and a few Spells
[/list]
This update has a lot of variables that are difficult to account for in a handful of tests, please let us know of any bugs you encounter! Thank you for your support! <3
Simon

notes.title: Traveler's Bastion - Spell Technique Update - March 26, 2023
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed Spell Maximum to 3 (Down from 4)
[*] Added a chance to replace a spell at Level 11
[*] Added Techniques
[*] Techniques can be applied to spells to enhance them
[*] Techniques are applied based on spell order, so you can change what it affects when upgrading
[*] There are eight at the moment, try to find them all!
[*] Added more appropriate sound effects for Water and DLC spells
[*] You will no longer be receiving duplicates of spells
[*] Fixed resolution bug (window moves off the monitor)
[*] Fixed bugs revolving around Air Rune
[*] Fixed bug revolving around bosses with multiple entities
[*] Fixed minor visual bug revolving around Spell and Attack icons
[*] Subtly Reworked how Attack Speed bonuses work
[*] Burning damage takes longer
[*] Reduced maximum spell level to 5 (Down from 8)
[*] Spell upgrade effectiveness increased to 20% (Up from 12.5%) to compensate
[*] Lava Bolt has been reworked
[*] Minor Balance Changes
[*] Reduced the effectiveness of World 3 enemy Charge ability
[*] Buffed World 4 Enemies
[*] Changed the Spell Upgrade menu to compensate for Techniques
[*] Added Arcane spells (For DLC players)
[/list]

notes.title: Spirit Guardians Expansion is now $5!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has supported the game so far. Good news is we have have had 1,542 players try the game (yahoo) and some great feedback! Sadly, our sales have not been so great so far we have sold 46 copies of the DLC and we have to split the revenue among two people.

My brother and I have been working on this full-time for three months and I took a risk by giving the game away for free and I know it is early but I would to break even eventually and it might not happen sadly.

I am not blaming anyone besides myself this is a self published game and I am still learning a lot all the time. I think I made the DLC too expensive anyways so I reduced the price to $5usd. So please consider getting it if you can afford it and we will be adding more stuff to it in the future as well. 

If you can't afford it please share the game with a friend or give us feedback to improve it. I made the game free because I wanted to receive more feedback anyways so it would be appreciated!

Thanks and enjoy the game!
- Jerome

notes.title: Traveler's Bastion Demo is Out!
notes.notes:
Hi again!

We have released a demo you can play on Steam which we will be updating and improving before the release of the game on Steam.

This will be like playing a Early Access of the game so you will not maintain your save in the full game but you can always go back and play the demo version later.

You can leave feedback here on Steam in the comments or in the forums. I will be checking it periodically so we can improve the game further. 

Enjoy!
- Jerome

notes.title: You Can Play Traveler's Bastion on Itch.io!
notes.notes:
Hello!

My brother and I have been working on this project for the last two months. It is a bullet heaven and tower defense mashup inspired by Vampire Survivors and Plants vs Zombies. We released the game on Itch.io and it had a great reception so Traveler's Bastion is now coming to Steam! Thank you to all the play tester who tried it out and gave us helpful feedback to improve the game.

In the meantime here is an early build of the game you can play now on Itch.io:
https://honest-rogue-games.itch.io/travelers-bastion

Enjoy!
- Jerome
